title: 国政は味方でも大阪では敵同士　大阪市議補選で維新と自民が激突　都構想議論は空振りか
extracted_text: 8日告示、17日投開票の大阪市議西区選挙区補欠選挙（欠員1）は1日、自民党元職と地域政党「大阪維新の会」新人の事実上の一騎打ちとなる構図が固まった。大阪都構想への3度目挑戦を掲げる維新代表の吉村洋文大阪府知事は、都構想の是非を打ち出して争点化を図る考えだが、維新市議団は都構想の議論開始に慎重だ。選挙戦術を巡り、維新内で温度差がある。 維新市議団の竹下隆幹事長は1日、公認候補の発表記者会見で、選挙結果と、都構想の設計図を作る法定協議会の早期設置について「すぐに結びつくとは考えていない」と述べた。 維新新人として立候補する会社役員の栗田裕也氏（46）は会見で、選挙戦では都構想実現を主張しつつも、地域コミュニティーの充実などを訴えていくとした。
translated_text: The by-election for Osaka City Council's Nishi Ward constituency (one vacancy), announced on the 8th with voting on the 17th, solidified on the 1st into a de facto head-to-head matchup between a former LDP member and a newcomer from the local party Osaka Innovation. Osaka Innovation representative and Osaka Prefectural Governor Yoshifumi Yoshimura, who is pushing for a third attempt at the Osaka Metro City concept, intends to make the issue of whether to implement the metro plan a campaign point. However, the Osaka Innovation city council group is cautious about starting discussions on the metro plan. There is a temperature difference within Osaka Innovation regarding election tactics. On the 1st, Osaka Innovation Secretary-General Takashi Takenoshita said at a press conference announcing the official candidacy that he does not think the election results will immediately lead to the early establishment of a statutory council to design the metro plan. Hiroyuki Kurita (46), a company executive running as an Osaka Innovation newcomer, said at the press conference that while advocating for metro plan realization in the campaign, he will also focus on enhancing local communities.
title_en: National Allies Become Osaka Opponents: LDP and Osaka Innovation Clash in City Council By-election; Metro Plan Debate May Come to Nothing
